core_obligations: Take an open V of X and g in O_V(V) vanishing on f^{-1}(W) intersect V, and assume g nonzero for a contradiction (proof lines 3434-3437).

Apply the go-down-with-annihilators lemma to shrink V and obtain an open U of S making V -> S factor through U, a quasi-coherent subsheaf F of O_U, an integer r and an injection F^{oplus r} -> pi_*O_V whose image contains g (proof lines 3437-3451).
Show that the components g_i of the preimage of g vanish on W intersect U because g vanishes on f^{-1}(W) intersect V (proof line 3452).
Conclude g_i = 0 by scheme theoretic density of W in S, hence g = 0, contradicting the assumption (proof lines 3453-3455).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a scheme theoretically dense open subscheme W of S and a morphism of schemes f : X -> S which is flat, locally of finite presentation and locally quasi-finite, the preimage f^{-1}(W) is scheme theoretically dense in X (source lines 3421-3429). The proof uses the characterization of scheme theoretic density by functions vanishing on the open: given an open V and g in O_V(V) restricting to zero on f^{-1}(W) intersect V, one assumes g nonzero and applies the go-down-with-annihilators lemma to shrink V and find U in S with a quasi-coherent subsheaf F of O_U, an integer r and an injection F^{oplus r} -> pi_*O_V containing g; the components g_i then vanish on W intersect U because g does, and vanish identically because W is scheme theoretically dense, forcing g = 0.
